recipes.title: 2-Ingredient Gluten-Free Donut Holes

items.i: self-rising gluten-free flour (e.g. Oatsome baking mix)
plain Greek yogurt (thick), plus 1–3 tbsp if dry

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Mix the flour and yogurt into a dough, using your hands if needed. Start with 1½ cups flour and add up to 2 cups only if it's too sticky; add 1–3 tbsp more yogurt if it's too dry.
Roll about 2 tbsp of dough into each ball and place on the sheet.
Bake 15–20 minutes until golden. Meanwhile mix the sugar and cinnamon.
While still warm, toss the donut holes in the melted butter, then in the cinnamon sugar.
recipes.notes: Recipe and nutrition are the creator's; the nutrition is per donut hole without the coating. For homemade self-rising flour add 1½ tsp baking powder and ¼ tsp salt per cup of gluten-free 1:1 flour. Best the same day; freeze uncoated up to a month.
